title: IOU (借据)
description:
[h1]IOU[/h1]
Adds a new shop relic, the [b]IOU[/b]. Every merchant sells it for 33 Gold until you buy it.

[b]Buy now, pay later[/b]
[list]
[*]Buy anything from the merchant on credit, owing up to [b]100[/b] Gold. Your Gold goes negative and turns red.
[*]While in debt, Gold from combat rewards is reduced by [b]30%[/b], or [b]50%[/b] if you owe more than 50.
[*]Gold you earn pays off the debt automatically.
[*]Once your debt is paid off, the IOU is used up and you cannot borrow again that run.
[/list]

[b]Requires [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3737335127]BaseLib[/url].[/b]

[h1]借据[/h1]
新增商店遗物[b]借据[/b]：每个商店都会以 33 金币出售，直到你买下为止。
[list]
[*]在商店购物时可以赊账，最多欠款 [b]100[/b] 金币，金币会变成红色的负数。
[*]负债期间，战斗获得的金币减少 [b]30%[/b]；欠款超过 50 时，改为减少 [b]50%[/b]。
[*]之后获得的金币会自动用来还债。
[*]还清欠款后，借据失效，本局不能再赊账。
[/list]

[b]需要先订阅 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3737335127]BaseLib[/url]。[/b]
